# XperiaDFPS

在索尼 Xperia 原厂固件（Android 14/15）上实现基于触控事件监听的动态刷新率控制（60Hz / 120Hz）。

Implement touch-driven dynamic refresh rate (60Hz / 120Hz) on Sony Xperia stock firmware (Android 14/15).

## 功能特性 / Features

- **触控驱动动态切换**：触碰屏幕立即切换 120Hz，停止操作约 3 秒后降为 60Hz。
- **分应用刷新率名单（热生效）**：
  - 锁定 60Hz 名单：`/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_60hz.txt`
  - 锁定 120Hz 名单：`/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_120hz.txt`
- **一键临时切换模式**：支持通过 Magisk 模块页 **「操作」** 按钮或 Shell 脚本在 `动态 60/120Hz → 全局 120Hz → 全局 60Hz` 间循环切换。

---

- **Touch-Driven Dynamic Switching**: Instantly ramps up to 120Hz on touch and drops to 60Hz after ~3 seconds of inactivity.
- **Per-App Refresh Rate Lists (Hot-Reload)**:
  - Force 60Hz list: `/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_60hz.txt`
  - Force 120Hz list: `/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_120hz.txt`
- **One-Tap Temporary Mode Toggle**: Cycle through `Dynamic 60/120Hz → Locked 120Hz → Locked 60Hz` via the Magisk module **Action** button or shell commands.

## 下载与安装 / Installation

1. 前往本仓库右侧 **[Releases](https://github.com/LinerFWZ/XperiaDFPS/releases)** 页面下载最新的 `XperiaDFPS-v*.zip`（**请勿**直接下载 GitHub 自动生成的 `Source code` 压缩包）。
2. 在 Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 中选择本地安装并重启手机。

---

1. Download the latest `XperiaDFPS-v*.zip` from the **[Releases](https://github.com/LinerFWZ/XperiaDFPS/releases)** page on the right (**do NOT** download the auto-generated `Source code` archive).
2. Flash it locally in Magisk / KernelSU / APatch and reboot your device.

## 使用说明 / Usage

### 1. 分应用锁定 60Hz / 120Hz | Per-App 60Hz / 120Hz Lock

编辑对应配置文件，每行填写一个应用包名，保存后自动生效，无需重启：
- 强制 60Hz：`/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_60hz.txt`
- 强制 120Hz：`/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_120hz.txt`

> 优先级：手动临时模式 ＞ `apps_60hz.txt` ＞ `apps_120hz.txt` ＞ 默认动态触控切换。

---

Edit the corresponding config file with one package name per line, changes take effect immediately without rebooting:
- Force 60Hz: `/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_60hz.txt`
- Force 120Hz: `/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/apps_120hz.txt`

> Priority: Manual temporary mode > `apps_60hz.txt` > `apps_120hz.txt` > Default dynamic touch switching.

### 2. 快捷切换Shell命令 | Quick Toggle Shell Commands

可绑定状态栏磁贴或自动化工具 / Can be bound to Quick Settings tiles or automation tools:

```bash
# 三档循环切换（动态 -> 120Hz -> 60Hz）
# Cycle through modes (Dynamic -> 120Hz -> 60Hz)
su -c "/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/toggle.sh cycle"

# 指定切换为对应模式（auto / 120 / 60）
# Switch directly to a specific mode (auto / 120 / 60)
su -c "/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/toggle.sh auto"
su -c "/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/toggle.sh 120"
su -c "/data/adb/modules/xperia_dfps/toggle.sh 60"
```

## 配套通知模块 / Companion Notification Module (Optional)

本模块本身不包含通知推送逻辑，如需在切换刷新率模式时获得视觉提示，可以搭配独立 LSPosed 模块 **[LinerXperiaNot](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.linerfwz.linerxperianot)** 使用：

- **功能效果**：切换模式时自动在屏幕顶部弹出**静音横幅提示**，并在 **5 秒后自动消失**。
- **安装方式**：在 LSPosed 管理器的「仓库」中直接搜索 `LinerXperiaNot`（包名 `io.github.linerfwz.linerxperianot`）下载安装。
- **启用配置**：在 LSPosed 中启用模块，作用域**仅勾选「系统界面（`com.android.systemui`）」**，重启系统界面或重启手机即可自动与本模块联动，无需额外设置。

---

This module does not send notifications on its own. If you want a visual indicator when switching refresh rate modes (Dynamic / 120Hz / 60Hz), you can pair it with the companion LSPosed module **[LinerXperiaNot](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.linerfwz.linerxperianot)**:

- **Behavior**: Displays a **silent heads-up notification** showing the active mode, which **auto-dismisses after 5 seconds**.
- **Installation**: Search for `LinerXperiaNot` (`io.github.linerfwz.linerxperianot`) directly in the LSPosed Manager repository.
- **Setup**: Enable the module with scope set **only to System UI (`com.android.systemui`)**, then restart System UI or reboot. It listens to `sf_rr_mode_event` automatically with zero extra configuration.
